overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns a pointer to the field designated by its table number and field number.

discriminatedBy.rule: Two Integer parameters (tableNum, fieldNum) -- forward lookup from numeric identifiers to a field pointer.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the field number of the field designated by a field pointer.

discriminatedBy.rule: A single Pointer parameter (fieldPtr) -- reverse lookup from a field pointer to its numeric field number.
